skill.summary: Local hybrid search for markdown notes and docs. Use when searching notes, finding related content, or retrieving documents from indexed collections.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the qmd skill: local hybrid search for Markdown notes and documents.
- Provides fast BM25 keyword search by default; semantic and hybrid search available as fallback.
- Guides installation and setup, with support for Bun and macOS/Linux.
- Documents search commands, retrieval options, and result formatting.
- Describes performance trade-offs and best practices for keeping indexes up to date.
- Notes how qmd complements Clawdbot’s agent memory search by indexing user files.
